title: Python: a refused site whose name is outside a partial star's known set is counted unbound, not star-bound ((a13) N3, (a69) item 3)
description: DEC-303 (a69) item 3. rules 33/45 skip a star that the code itself holds as partial (an __all__ that may be unbound, GCLI-136) when the name is outside the star's export set, so the refused name falls through to rule 37 and the site is recorded with reason 'unbound' (calls.ts resolveBareName ~2350), where (a13) N3 says a partial star reached first leaves the name star-bound and unresolved. Measured on GCLI-136: the bin is nameNotBound either way, and the reason feeds only the unresolvedNameReasons breakdown (calls.ts 4329-4330, 4377); no edge is made or lost and no denominator or bin changes. Opum-doc confirmed the blind-sample procedure does not read the reason breakdown; the condition is that no reason figure goes into the pre-registration while it is open. Ordinary, not on the hold list; do not start before GCLI-121 is sequenced.

acceptanceCriteria.text: for a name outside the known set of a star the code holds as partial (an __all__ in a skippable statement, a non-literal __all__ is already star-bound), the site is recorded with reason star-bound, red before and green after, one fixture
no bin, edge, polymorphic or multiplyBound count changes: the five-pin output stays byte-identical to dev
a positive twin where the star is exact and the name is genuinely unbound keeps reason unbound
